source_behavior.summary: CommentsManager renders the authoritative WordPress comment.Link as an Open external anchor when a link exists.
source_behavior.wordpress_behavior: the link value originates from the WordPress comments REST read and is persisted with the tenant-owned Comment record; clicking does not mutate WordPress
source_behavior.success_semantics: navigation only; no mutation success, receipt, or fake completion state exists

laravel_adaptation.wordpress_ingest: App\Content\ContentPlatformService persists row['link'] into Comment.link during authoritative comments synchronization
laravel_adaptation.runtime_wiring: CommentsCommentLinksControl is mounted directly by RouteElement for route.key === 'comments', independently of previously closed Comments navigation controls
laravel_adaptation.destination_source: authoritative Comment.link returned by the tenant/site comments API

runtime_path: authenticated session enters the explicit tenant/site Comments route
tenant.context resolves an active membership for the route tenant and activates TenantContext inside a bounded try/finally scope
content.view is required before the tenant-scoped Site is resolved; foreign or missing source Site direct IDs fail closed
the real Comments workspace mounts CommentsCommentLinksControl directly and receives the server-advertised tenant/site comments API contract
GET comments authorizes content.view again and queries Comment through tenant global scope plus site_id
Comment.link is the persisted value previously ingested from the authoritative WordPress comments REST row
the React control reads only the server-advertised same-origin comments endpoint and never accepts a destination from query, route, form, or DOM input
only absolute HTTP(S) persisted links without embedded credentials render as clickable external anchors
unsafe or malformed persisted destinations remain non-navigable and produce no synthesized fallback
clicking the safe anchor performs external navigation only and never reports mutation success

authorization.session_requirement: ResolveTenantContext rejects requests without an authenticated user with 401 before tenant activation

tenant_isolation.active_tenant_resolution: route tenant must resolve to an active membership for the authenticated user
tenant_isolation.site_resolution: source workspace resolves Site through active TenantContext and rejects a foreign direct ID with 404
tenant_isolation.api_record_scope: Comment global tenant scope plus site_id ensures a foreign-site identifier under the active tenant returns an empty authoritative collection rather than foreign rows

validation_and_link_safety.same_origin_api_request: the server-advertised API endpoint is normalized to pathname+search before fetch, so an absolute foreign API origin cannot be followed

runtime_semantics.csrf_write_path: not applicable; the operation and its backing fetch are GET/read-only
runtime_semantics.persistence: authoritative Comment.link is reread; the operation makes no persistence change
runtime_semantics.authoritative_reread: each rendered destination is sourced from the current tenant/site comments read contract, not browser-supplied state
runtime_semantics.truthful_success: no success state exists; API error or unsafe destination fails closed without a link
runtime_semantics.idempotency: repeated reads and navigation do not mutate domain state
runtime_semantics.retry: read retries are side-effect free; no mutation retry semantics apply
runtime_semantics.cancellation: no long-running mutation or cancellable job is created
runtime_semantics.secret_exposure: no credentials, Connector secrets, provider secrets, or internal tokens are rendered; credential-bearing external URLs are rejected
runtime_semantics.wordpress_connector_safety: no WordPress or AIMW Connector mutation is performed
runtime_semantics.ai_provider_safety: not applicable; no AI/provider call is performed
runtime_semantics.audit_or_receipt: not applicable because no domain mutation occurs

proof: exact canonical operation identity and source metadata
direct runtime mounting in the real Comments RouteElement independent of previously closed navigation controls
persisted authoritative WordPress comment link returned despite caller query override
HTTP(S)-only destination allowlist and rejection of javascript/data/file/relative/malformed/credential-bearing values
foreign tenant and source-workspace foreign Site direct-ID 404
foreign-site API lookup cannot disclose foreign persisted comment link
backing read leaves the persisted Comment unchanged
no POST/PATCH/DELETE path, fake success, secret, queue, scheduler, provider, or Connector mutation

terminality.reason: The source external comment-link behavior is implemented on the real tenant/site Comments runtime using the authoritative persisted WordPress comment link, with direct comments-route mounting, session/tenant/permission isolation, and strict fail-closed URL validation. No caller-controlled redirect, mutation, fake success, or secret exposure is introduced. Exact pushed provenance is generator-owned through operation-parity-evidence-sources.json.
